'''Maldinian City''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kerkoidia/Legends|Kerkoidia]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Kerkoiden/Legends|Kerkoiden]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TCWCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Maldianian City was mentioned in the [[2010]] roleplaying game sourcebook ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="TCWCG" />
